stage_at_freeze: Raw archive, labels, GPS dates and spatial overlap inspected; no KIT models fitted and no KIT prediction outcomes computed
purpose: Independent-source, fixed-candidate validation of model selection and estimation, with a final untouched acquisition date and task-specific engineering diagnostics
source: Masino et al., DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1461243; original paper DOI 10.1155/2018/8647607; public CC BY 4.0 archive
source_semantics: One BMW 116d and LSM9DS1 IMU; not a cross-vehicle test. Use IMU workbooks only; Schlag excerpts can duplicate IMU samples and are excluded. Fifty-three workbooks are not fifty-three independent roads or drives
clock_policy: Use decoded ISO GPS dates for acquisition-date groups. Numeric timestamps disagree with calendar dates, but remain monotone within file and are used only for within-file window duration. Exclude files without one unambiguous GPS date
target: Source e=1 good maps to 0; e=3 pothole maps to 1. All other source codes, including unknown 0 and unresolved 7, excluded from labelled evaluation and never redefined as good
window: Trailing one second [decision-1, decision], decision=t_first+1+j*0.25, through file end; anchor is last raw timestamp <=decision. At least 50 raw rows, no gap >0.1s, all six inertial axes finite; anchor label 1/3 and finite plausible Karlsruhe-region coordinates (48<=lat<=50,7<=lon<=10). Keep source row intervals
representation: 30 axis-major statistics over C:H source axes: mean, population std, RMS, range, max absolute; optional anchor lat/lon/speed as 3 context fields. No label, file/date identity or absolute timestamp as predictor
spatial_buffer: Project with fixed cos(49 degrees), x=(lon-8.4)*111320*cos(49), y=(lat-49)*111320. For final development pools purge every training window if any raw coordinate in its span is nonfinite/outside region or lies <=100m from any eligible final-test anchor. For grouped-date inner validation additionally purge training windows within100m of eligible validation anchors using the same full-window rule. Keep held-out observations unchanged
random_split: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=2,shuffle=True,random_state=42) on final-test-purged development population; intentionally estimates interpolation with overlapping windows allowed. Save exact split arrays before fitting
date_split: Each remaining development date in turn supplies validation and the other training, with the additional 100m buffer. Save exact split arrays before fitting
common_inner_training_budget: Across all four inner training pools, minimum available class-0 and class-1 counts define shared per-class fit counts. Deterministic no-replacement subsampling seed42+split_position; identical memberships for all candidates. Validation unchanged. Abort without fitting if any training or validation pool lacks either class. No protocol rescue after outcomes
model_settings: Reuse external_pvs_v1/run_nested_evaluation.py make_model and matrix conventions; RF100 depth20 leaf5 sqrt balanced, HGB100 iterations leaves31 lr0.1 L2=1 balanced early_stopping=False, seed42; median imputation fitted only to actual fit rows
selection: Max pooled inner OOF macro-F1 with fixed candidate-order tie break. Save selected candidate and inner scores before any final-test prediction
outer_primary: Refit selected candidates on all eligible purged development observations, cap20000 stratified if needed; same final refit shared between selectors selecting same candidate. Outer macro-F1 and abs(saved inner macro-F1 minus same selected outer macro-F1), not a three-domain MAE
outer_secondary: Use the common inner per-class budget for final refits, with fixed shared subsample, to separate training-size target. Report separately from full-development target
engineering: For each selector full-development chosen system only: source-label annotation interval recall, non-event alarm clusters and redundant event-associated clusters. Pothole intervals are contiguous source e=3 runs split by >.1s gaps, evaluable only if a final-test decision anchor falls inside. Consecutive positive decisions merge only when decision-grid adjacent (<=.251s) with no intervening retained negative or excluded grid step. Zero tolerance primary; .5s sensitivity. Maximum one-to-one event/alarm matching. An alarm with no eligible event edge is a non-event alarm; unmatched alarms with an event edge are duplicate notifications. Good exposure is explicit e=1 raw rows between first and last retained decision per file, sum min(next dt,.1), final row median positive dt. No distance or physical latency claim
uncertainty: Only one final held-out date; report raw class, interval and exposure denominators, no confidence interval from windows or repeated events, no claim of independent roads from files or intervals
integrity: Save source hashes, script hashes, environment, exact memberships and fitted models/predictions. Assert source row overlap absent across date partitions; assert full-window buffer minimum >100m; reload check predictions. Append-only new run; refuse overwrite
claims: This validates the frozen evaluation workflow on another source and date, not a repaired universal method. Original PVS two-axis failure remains. Outcomes reported regardless of direction; no change to candidates, thresholds, buffers or final date after results
